'''John Trouba''' won the [[1997 Bespin Regionals (Minneapolis)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"Age 34."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/trouba.html John Trouba], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428115615/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/trouba.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"Married to a beautiful lady with whom I enjoy dabbling in the outdoors and watching movies."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I am involved in local political campaigns and neighborhood improvement organizations."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I work as a community development consultant assisting counties, villages and cities with community and economic development activities."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite actor is Alec Guinness."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite character is Sidney Reilly from the PBS series Reilly:Ace of Spies (played by Sam Neill)."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I look forward to the Finals and meeting the folks at Decipher."<ref name="dec97bio" />
